record.paper_title: I Teoremi di Campbell, Baker, Hausdorff e Dynkin. Storia, Prove, Problemi Aperti.
record.original_question: Let x and y be noncommuting elements in a normed setting where the Campbell-Baker-Hausdorff-Dynkin expansion for log(exp(x)exp(y)) is studied, and write the homogeneous-component CBHD form as a sum of homogeneous terms Z_j(x,y). What is the optimal convergence domain for this homogeneous-component CBHD series, and how can one characterize its pointwise convergence?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\mathcal{A}, \|\cdot\|)$ be a unital Banach algebra (over $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$), and for $x,y\in\mathcal{A}$ consider the Campbell–Baker–Hausdorff–Dynkin (CBHD) expansion of $\log(\exp(x)\exp(y))$ grouped by total degree:
$$\log(\exp(x)\exp(y)) \;=\; \sum_{j=1}^{\infty} Z_j(x,y),$$
where $Z_j(x,y)$ is the homogeneous Lie polynomial in $x,y$ of total degree $j$ obtained from Dynkin's formula
$$Z_j(x,y)=\frac{1}{j}\sum_{\substack{p+q=j\\ p,q\ge 0}}\sum_{\substack{p_i+q_i\ge 1}}\frac{(-1)^{n-1}}{n}\frac{[x^{p_1}y^{q_1}\cdots x^{p_n}y^{q_n}]}{p_1!q_1!\cdots p_n!q_n!},$$
the inner bracket denoting the iterated commutator (left-nested) ending in $x$ or $y$ according to whether $q_n=0$ or $q_n\ge 1$.

Determine the optimal (i.e. largest) domain $D\subseteq\mathcal{A}\times\mathcal{A}$ on which the series $\sum_{j\ge 1} Z_j(x,y)$ converges in $\mathcal{A}$, and give a characterization of those pairs $(x,y)\in\mathcal{A}\times\mathcal{A}$ for which the homogeneous-component series converges pointwise to $\log(\exp(x)\exp(y))$.
artifact.status_search_result: Determining the optimal/sharp convergence domain of the homogeneous-component CBHD series and characterizing its pointwise convergence remains an active research topic. Various sufficient conditions and improved estimates have been published (e.g., works on convergence in finite- and infinite-dimensional Banach–Lie algebras and on optimization of BCH convergence bounds), but no result establishing the optimal domain together with a sharp pointwise-convergence characterization appears to have been obtained.

status_evidence.title: On the convergence and optimization of the Baker–Campbell–Hausdorff formula
status_evidence.snippet: Previous results about the convergence domain are collected and new estimates that improve all of them are presented.
status_evidence.claim: The exact optimal convergence domain has not been settled; improvements to known bounds continue to appear.

status_evidence.title: On the convergence of the Campbell–Baker–Hausdorff–Dynkin series in infinite-dimensional Banach–Lie algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Convergence results for the CBHD series in infinite-dimensional Banach–Lie algebras are proven, extending previous investigations.
status_evidence.claim: Research continues on extending and sharpening convergence results, indicating the optimal domain question remains open.

status_evidence.title: Baker–Campbell–Hausdorff formula - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: The series describes formal power series whose convergence is not guaranteed; one has to assume X and Y are small.
status_evidence.claim: General convergence characterization is not known; only sufficient smallness conditions are given.
